question: Find all posts created in 2014 that have no comments, identify the post with the highest favorite count among them, return the display name of its owner, and calculate the percentage of all posts by this owner that have a score greater than 5.

prediction.sql:
WITH no_comment_posts_2014 AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_039 AS favorite_count, p.XCL_033 AS owner_id
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM comments c
          WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      )
),
top_post AS (
    SELECT owner_id
    FROM no_comment_posts_2014
    ORDER BY favorite_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 = (SELECT owner_id FROM top_post)
GROUP BY u.XCL_052

WITH no_comment_posts_2014 AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_039 AS favorite_count, p.XCL_033 AS owner_id
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM comments c
          WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      )
),
top_post AS (
    SELECT owner_id
    FROM no_comment_posts_2014
    ORDER BY favorite_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 = (SELECT owner_id FROM top_post)
GROUP BY u.XCL_052

WITH no_comment_posts_2014 AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_031 AS favorite_count, p.XCL_033 AS owner_id
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND c.XCL_006 IS NULL
),
top_post AS (
    SELECT owner_id
    FROM no_comment_posts_2014
    ORDER BY favorite_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_030 > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 = (SELECT owner_id FROM top_post)
GROUP BY u.XCL_052

WITH posts_2014_no_comments AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_033 AS owner_id, p.XCL_037 AS favorite_count
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM comments c
          WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      )
),
top_post AS (
    SELECT owner_id
    FROM posts_2014_no_comments
    ORDER BY favorite_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
owner_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_posts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_030 > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_score_posts
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT owner_id FROM top_post)
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_057 AS display_name,
    (os.high_score_posts * 100.0 / os.total_posts) AS percentage
FROM top_post tp
JOIN users u ON u.XCL_052 = tp.owner_id
JOIN owner_stats os ON 1=1
